$description: Every raster and pixel asset with its group and alt text. scripts/export.ts and scripts/generate.ts read this file; the manifest test checks it against the files on disk.

scenes.title: No vaults yet
scenes.alt: An empty dock with an unlit lantern, a coiled rope and a moored canoe; the storehouse stands far off across the morning water.

scenes.title: Choose a profile
scenes.alt: Three small docks side by side along one shore at evening, each with its own lit lantern and moored canoe.

scenes.title: Run your keeper on a server
scenes.alt: A tall tiered lantern tower on its own island sends one beam across the night lake to a member's canoe.

scenes.title: Create a vault
scenes.alt: On its island at morning, builders lay the first course of the storehouse beside a pile of cut stone, a supply canoe moored below.

scenes.title: Share an invite
scenes.alt: A member in a canoe sets three paper boats on the water, each heading toward a different shore.

scenes.title: Ask to join
scenes.alt: At dusk a lone canoe sends a paper boat toward canoes gathered at the lit storehouse.

scenes.title: Waiting for co-founders
scenes.alt: Canoes gather around the storehouse island at dusk: two moored, a third arriving with its lantern lit, an hourglass on the steps.

scenes.title: Invite for another network
scenes.alt: A canoe waits where the lake meets pale, misty water of another colour; its paper boat is stopped at a line of stakes.

scenes.title: Generating the shared key
scenes.alt: Three lantern towers around the night lake send beams that meet in one orb above the storehouse.

scenes.title: Deploying the vault
scenes.alt: At dawn the storehouse stands in scaffolding as its roof goes on, the orb of light settling onto it.

scenes.title: Founding stopped
scenes.alt: Rain falls on the half-built storehouse under a tarp; canoes shelter at its steps. A pause, not a ruin.

scenes.title: Vault founded
scenes.alt: A clear sunrise lights the finished storehouse; three canoes with lanterns wait at its steps and birds pass overhead.

scenes.title: Balances
scenes.alt: Inside the storehouse, shelves hold jars, baskets and a chest, with the flowering gardens through the door.

scenes.title: No tokens yet
scenes.alt: Inside the storehouse the shelves stand empty; through the open door, mist over a bare garden plot.

scenes.title: Receive
scenes.alt: Four paper boats arrive one behind another at the storehouse's steps on a bright day.

scenes.title: Payment received
scenes.alt: At dawn a canoe heavy with goods glides in to the storehouse's steps, a basket set out to receive it.

scenes.title: Make a proposal
scenes.alt: On the dock a quill rests on an unrolled scroll beside a freshly folded paper boat, ready for the water.

scenes.title: Reviewing a proposal
scenes.alt: A heron leans over a paper boat on the dock, studying it, with a pale and a dark stone set beside.

scenes.title: Waiting for approvals
scenes.alt: At dusk, a stone voting box holds one of two stones between a lit lantern and a dark one.

scenes.title: Enough approvals
scenes.alt: At dusk the stone voting box holds both stones; the lanterns on either side are lit, their light on the water.

scenes.title: Preparing the transaction
scenes.alt: In the mist two lanterns pour light into a glowing orb above the water while a canoe waits; an hourglass stands on the ledge.

scenes.title: Sending
scenes.alt: A canoe with its lantern lit cuts fast across the day lake, a long wake streaming behind it.

scenes.title: Done
scenes.alt: Under a clear morning sun the canoe has reached a far chinampa, its paper boat delivered on the bank.

scenes.title: Can't proceed
scenes.alt: At dusk a canoe has stopped where the causeway is broken, dark stones heaped at the gap.

scenes.title: Expired
scenes.alt: At sunset a paper boat lies stranded in the reeds, an emptied hourglass on the post above it.

scenes.title: Cancelled
scenes.alt: A faded paper boat drifts in the mist past an unlit lantern.

scenes.title: Out of date
scenes.alt: In the mist an empty canoe is tied to an unlit post, an old map left curling on the dock.

scenes.title: Nothing waiting
scenes.alt: Calm water on a clear day, birds over the lake, the storehouse at rest on its island.

scenes.title: No activity yet
scenes.alt: Still morning water with large lily pads in the foreground and one quiet chinampa beyond.

scenes.title: Counterparties
scenes.alt: Small canoes spread across the day lake from the storehouse, each on its own dotted route.

scenes.title: A member joining
scenes.alt: Two canoes rest at the storehouse's steps as a third approaches across the day lake.

scenes.title: A member leaving
scenes.alt: At dusk two canoes stay at the storehouse's steps while a third paddles away.

scenes.title: Resharing
scenes.alt: Three canoes with lanterns float in a ring at night, light passing from one lantern to the next.

scenes.title: Sharing the membership plan
scenes.alt: Paper boats fan out from one canoe across the day lake, each toward a different member.

scenes.title: A new set of keepers
scenes.alt: At sunrise new lantern posts burn in a ring around the storehouse, the old ones dark behind them.

scenes.title: Two members connecting
scenes.alt: Two canoes meet bow to bow at dusk, their lanterns held close together.

scenes.title: Vault health good
scenes.alt: On a clear day three lit lanterns stand around the storehouse.

scenes.title: Vault health low
scenes.alt: At dusk three lanterns stand around the storehouse; two are lit, one dark.

scenes.title: Can't read the vault
scenes.alt: In night fog one lantern still burns by the storehouse; the other two are dark.

scenes.title: Your keeper
scenes.alt: One tall lantern burns on its post at the water's edge at night.

scenes.title: Relays
scenes.alt: At dusk a causeway links two chinampas; the lanterns at each end trade one steady beam.

scenes.title: Peers
scenes.alt: Five lanterns across the night lake, joined by dotted beams of light.

scenes.title: A member's keeper offline
scenes.alt: In night fog two lanterns hold a beam between them while a third stands dark.

scenes.title: The keeper's audit log
scenes.alt: A carved stela with rows of tally marks stands lit by a lantern at the water's edge at night.

scenes.title: Paired phones
scenes.alt: Three small canoes at night, each carrying a little lantern linked by light to the lantern on the dock.

scenes.title: No paired phones
scenes.alt: In the mist an empty dock with one unlit hand lantern left on its boards.

scenes.title: Removed from the vault
scenes.alt: At dusk a lone canoe drifts away from the lit storehouse, its lantern dark.

scenes.title: Starting Ome
scenes.alt: At first light beacon posts around the lake catch one after another, from bright to not yet lit.

scenes.title: Ome's daemon stopped
scenes.alt: Rain at night: the dock's lantern tower is dark, and a figure with a small hand lantern looks up at it.

scenes.title: Can't reach the network
scenes.alt: Thick fog hides the far shore; a causeway runs out from the foreground and vanishes into it.

scenes.title: Catching up
scenes.alt: On a clear day a long flock of birds crosses the sky above a canoe moving steadily across the lake.

scenes.title: Vault alarm
scenes.alt: At night a brick-red signal fire burns on a platform beside the storehouse, its light running across the water.

scenes.title: Signer locked
scenes.alt: The storehouse door at night, shut with a carved stone seal, a lantern burning beside it.

scenes.title: Signer unlocked
scenes.alt: At dawn the storehouse door stands open on warm light, a lit lantern beside it and a canoe tied up below.

scenes.title: Not found
scenes.alt: Fog over empty water, rings spreading where something used to be.

scenes.title: Profile not set up
scenes.alt: In the mist an empty dock holds a coiled rope beside an unlit post; no canoe is tied there.

scenes.title: Testnet
scenes.alt: In the mist a small practice canoe floats near the shore beside two paper boats and a striped marker pole.
